name: ai-setup
description: Role-based agent environment setup — give it an engineer's role and stack (e.g. "React frontend engineer") and, after a few questions, it plans, applies, and verifies the whole setup: vetted existing skills, plugins, and MCP servers found by parallel subagents; stack best-practice skills researched from current primary sources for the versions in use; global and repo-level agent instructions; permissions, hooks, and a verification loop; plus a how-to-work playbook.
